All 19 backend API tests passed. Frontend Script Editor UI fully functional with dialogue blocks, character selection, director notes, save, and generate features. Admin Voice Generation Controls page includes batch_size configuration.

critical_code_review_comments: Script Editor properly handles structured dialogue data with character_id, voice_id, text, and director_notes
Background generation via asyncio.create_task - polling required for status
Batch size config at 10 dialogues per API batch (configurable 2-20)
Multi-speaker batching logic: max 2 speakers per Gemini API call
Audio caching implemented using cache_key from text+voice+notes hash
context_for_next_testing_agent: Script Compiler system fully functional. Script Editor at /studio/{storyId}/script shows episodes sidebar (left) and dialogue blocks (center). Each dialogue block has: index number, character selector dropdown, dialogue text textarea, director notes input. Save saves to script_content JSON in episodes table. Generate Audio triggers POST /api/script/{episode_id}/generate which creates background job - poll GET /api/script/job/{job_id}/status for progress. Admin batch_size config at /admin-access/generation under 'Script Compiler Batch Size'. Gemini TTS API may return 429 rate limits - expected in test env.
